_README: Suburbs a stock document cannot state for itself, checked by hand against the developer's own published address. Each rule may match three ways, most precise first: `url` is the exact source_url; `project` is a lowercase substring tested against the row's builder_name and estate_name; `title` is a lowercase substring tested against the document's own front page. url alone is NOT enough -- builders re-upload price lists to fresh links and the rows follow the new URL, so a url-only rule silently stops applying and those listings go back to having no suburb. Keep `evidence` filled in: it is what lets the next person re-check the claim instead of trusting it.

rules.evidence: Victoria & Albert, 20 Albert Ave Broadbeach QLD 4218
Ancora at Collins Wharf, 971 Collins St Docklands VIC 3008
rules.title: collins wharf

The Fawkner, Fawkner Park / St Kilda Road, Melbourne VIC 3004 - the tower fronts St Kilda Road; 'Fawkner Park West' is the release name, and Fawkner itself is a suburb 15 km north that this project has nothing to do with
The Millwell, 2 Millwell Road East, Maroochydore QLD 4558 (Habitat Development Group). Millwell Road is in Maroochydore, not Morayfield
Aston Junction, 493 Mountain Highway, Bayswater VIC 3153 - industrial unit development. Bayswater also exists in WA, so the state is pinned here
